context: Push from a Go service without leaking the token

checklist.name: env_config
checklist.description: Passes the token through `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT`, `GIT_CONFIG_KEY_n`, and `GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_n` (or an equivalent that keeps it out of argv), not `-c` on the command line.

checklist.name: no_url_token
checklist.description: Never embeds the token in the remote URL or writes it to `.git/config`.

checklist.name: scrubbed_errors
checklist.description: Removes the token from git output before it reaches an error or a log line.

checklist.name: no_prompt
checklist.description: Sets `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0` so an expired token fails fast instead of hanging.

checklist.name: plain_push
checklist.description: Uses an ordinary `git push` with no partial clone (`--filter`) on the clone.
